functions.name: Count
functions.docs:
Count a Normal in the histogram, ie find the Bin it should be included in and add the Weight to that Bin (The Normal does not strictly need to be normalized)
@param Weight optional weight for this normal

functions.name: FindMaxNormal
functions.docs: @return the normal direction for the Histogram bin that contains the most points / largest mass

functions.name: WeightedSpreadMetric
functions.docs: Attempt to compute a measure of the range of variation in normals across the occupied bins
